summary: Explore fire-class recognition, NFPA 10 extinguisher selection and safe first response. Review the course outline and practical outcomes.
lede: Fire fighting training helps workplace fire wardens, facilities teams and first responders make safe initial fire-response decisions. Participants practise recognizing fire classes, selecting and inspecting portable extinguishers, raising alarms, and deciding when to withdraw. Exercises also develop response checklists and decision cards, and build skills in recording drill observations and prioritizing corrective actions.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who make or support initial fire-response decisions, inspect portable extinguishers or coordinate workplace readiness. It focuses on safe first response rather than professional fire-service qualification.
prerequisites: No prior firefighting qualification is assumed. You should be able to follow workplace safety instructions and take part in scenario-based exercises.
